summary: Iteration 12 — Super Admin Dashboard additions (Platform user CRUD, Detailed tenant view, CSV export, Delete tenant, Subscription audit trail). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass against the public URL. Frontend: 6 Playwright flows (mobile 390x844) all pass — verified toolbar buttons (Download Report + Manage Users), per-tenant View Details + role-gated Delete button, Tenant Detail screen (Business Info + Subscription History with 7 entries + Branches list with addresses), Manage Users screen (create staff user w/ role toggle + hint text), and staff-role restrictions (Delete/New-User buttons hidden). All 3 new features and the platform_staff role gating work end-to-end. Deprecated packages / RN issues detected: none functional-blocking. Console warnings observed (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props deprecated (existing across StyleSheets since iter11), 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (RN-Web modal).

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated in React Native Web (repeat from iter11 — migrate to boxShadow).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking; likely inside react-native-web Modal internals.

action_items: None P0/P1. Existing action items from iter11 (split server.py into routers; migrate shadow* -> boxShadow) still stand.
critical_code_review_comments: Naming: `require_platform_admin` in fact allows BOTH platform_admin and platform_staff (used for read + non-destructive actions). Function is correctly used but the name is misleading — consider renaming to `require_any_platform_user` and keeping `require_platform_super` for admin-only.
server.py grew to 2885 lines (from 2607). Splitting into routers becomes more urgent (platform/tenants/branches/appointments modules).

In `platform_delete_tenant` the code does per-collection `delete_many` in a loop — not transactional. If a mid-loop failure occurs, tenant may end up partially purged. Acceptable for a mock/demo SaaS but flag for future robustness (bulk_write or explicit compensating logic).
PlatformUserUpdate: `name` field is currently updatable but no length/emptiness validation — an empty string would replace the display name.
CSV export: `docs = await db.tenants.find(...).to_list(2000)` uses hard cap 2000. Fine for now; consider streaming/pagination if tenant count grows.

tenant-detail.tsx does not surface a Delete button — good separation. But the screen also does not gate viewing by role client-side; backend guard (require_platform_admin allowing both roles) is the sole enforcement — this is intentional and correct.
